description: Turns a polyphonic CV and gate pair into eight separate gates, one for each semitone from C4 to G4, for driving drum modules or gating mixer channels from a sequencer

inputs.text: The pitch CV, quantised to semitones; a channel whose pitch lands on one of the eight semitones from 0V upwards raises that gate
The gate for each channel of the CV input, which raises the output belonging to that channel's pitch

outputs.text: Goes high while a channel is playing the semitone this jack belongs to, with the lamp beside it following it

notes: both the CV input and the Gate input have to be patched: the number of gates that can open is the smaller of the two cables' channel counts, and with either one empty no output goes high
